n108509.source: Plutarchus, Quomodo adulator ab amico internoscatur (48e-74e), ed. Grēgorios N. Vernardakēs, Leipzig 1888 (Perseus)

n108509.source: Plutarchus, Quomodo adulator ab amico internoscatur (48e-74e), ed. Grēgorios N. Vernardakēs, Leipzig 1888 (Perseus)
